$\Omega$ 是空心球体 $a^2\leq x^2+y^2+z^2\leq b^2(0<a<b)$，则 $\iiint_\Omega\sin(x^2+y^2+z^2)^{3/2}\,dv=$（ ） $\frac{4\pi}{3}(\cos^3a-\cos^3b)$ $\frac{4\pi}{3}(\cos a^3-\cos b^3)$ $\frac{4\pi}{3}(\cos a^3+\cos b^3)$ $\frac{4\pi}{3}(\cos b^3-\cos a^3)$ $\iiint_\Omega\sin(x^2+y^2+z^2)^{\frac{3}{2}}\,dv=\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^\pi d\varphi\int_a^b\sin(r^3)r^2\sin\varphi\,d\rho$

$=\frac{2\pi}{3}\int_0^\pi\sin\varphi\,d\varphi\int_a^b\sin(r^3)\,dr^3=\frac{2\pi}{3}\cdot2\cdot(-\cos r^3)\big|_a^b$

$=\frac{4\pi}{3}(-\cos b^3+\cos a^3)$
